FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 143
Committee: Veterans and Military Affairs Sponsor: Senator Wes Kitchens
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/12/2025
Senate Bill 143 as introduced could decrease receipts to certain counties and municipalities by
an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of solid waste collection fees that would
not be collected from households whose sole source of income is veterans' benefits, as provided
by this bill.
